# platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Admin — Federation Rules

> 9 page(s) of platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Admin under Federation Rules. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Federation Rules

- [Add Federation Rule Workspace](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/federation_rules/workspaces/create.md): Tagged ID of the workspace to enable this rule for.
- [Archive Federation Rule](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/federation_rules/archive.md): Archive a federation rule.
- [Create Federation Rule](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/federation_rules/create.md): Create a federation rule owned by your organization.
- [Get Federation Rule](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/federation_rules/retrieve.md): Retrieve a federation rule by its ID (`fdrl_...`).
- [List Federation Rule Workspaces](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/federation_rules/workspaces/list.md): When this workspace was enabled for the rule.
- [List Federation Rules](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/federation_rules/list.md): Include archived resources. Defaults to false.
- [Remove Federation Rule Workspace](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/federation_rules/workspaces/delete.md): Disable a federation rule for a workspace.
- [Update Federation Rule](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/federation_rules/update.md): Partially update a federation rule.
- [Workspaces](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/federation_rules/workspaces.md): When this workspace was enabled for the rule.
